## FAQ
Q1. What is FitAlliance Pro?
A1. FitAlliance Pro is a fitness community and coaching hub for trainers and studio owners, with programs, check-ins, a coach dashboard, and a community feed.
Q2. What does the coach dashboard show?
A2. It rolls up member progress so a trainer sees who is on track at a glance.
Q3. Can members track progress?
A3. Yes. Members log progress and it shows up in the coach dashboard and their own view.
Q4. Is there a community feature?
A4. A community feed keeps members connected and engaged between sessions.
Q5. Who should use it?
A5. Trainers and studio owners who want programs, coaching, and community in one place.
Q6. Does it replace several tools?
A6. It combines programs, check-ins, progress, and community that are often split across separate apps.
